name: Elderflower Grapefruit Margarita
desc: A long tequila and grapefruit margarita sweetened with St-Germain and Cointreau.

source.title: Elderflower Grapefruit Margaritas
source.evidence: Same core of tequila, St-Germain, grapefruit juice and lime with a salt rim; Freutcake adds cherry syrup and skips the orange liqueurs.

ingredients.raw: 1 tbsp coarse salt, for the rim

steps: Pick a part size: 3/4 oz per part makes one tall drink of about 7 oz (1 1/2 oz tequila), 1/2 oz per part makes one rocks-glass drink, and 1/2 cup per part makes a pitcher for about 6.
Spread the salt on a small plate. Rub the lime wedge around the glass rim, dip the rim in the salt, and fill the glass with fresh ice.
Add the tequila, lime juice, grapefruit juice, Cointreau, St-Germain and Grand Marnier (if using) to a shaker with ice.
Shake vigorously until the outside of the shaker is frosty, about 15 seconds.
tips: For more body, swap some of the Cointreau for a splash of fresh orange juice.
Published elderflower grapefruit margaritas run far less juice (Thistle Key Lane uses 3/4 oz grapefruit to 2 oz tequila); this one is long and juice-forward on purpose.

references.title: Elderflower Grapefruit Margaritas
references.usedFor: salt rim, grapefruit plus lime build
